_comment: Version contract for the legacy incumbent used by every vs-incumbent perf claim.
A competitive ratio is only bankable against a PINNED incumbent: without this file,
'franken is 2x faster than whisper.cpp' silently means 'faster than whatever binary
happened to sit at that path on that day, built with whatever flags'.
examples/incumbent_ab.rs loads this file at preflight and FAILS CLOSED when the
running incumbent process image, or the vendored source version, drifts from it.
Updating the incumbent is legal; updating it silently is not. Bump the digests here
in the same commit, and prior ledger rows keep pointing at the digests they used.
GGML_NATIVE=ON compiles -march=native, so the incumbent is built FOR this host and
gets its AVX2/F16C/FMA. GGML_AVX2:BOOL=OFF in CMakeCache is not a downgrade: that
switch only applies when GGML_NATIVE is off. Recorded because a competitive claim
against an ISA-hobbled incumbent would be worthless, and franken ships AVX2.
GGML_OPENMP=ON means the incumbent has a persistent OpenMP pool, i.e. it does not
pay per-call thread spawn. That is the incumbent at its strongest on CPU.
Both arms are driven from these values in one place. Greedy-vs-beam is the easiest
way to accidentally fabricate a speedup: whisper-cli defaults to beam_size 5 and
best_of 5, which would make the incumbent do ~5x the decode work franken does.
temperature_fallback=false matches franken, whose fallback ladder is gated off by
default (FW_TEMP_FALLBACK); leaving the incumbent's -tpi 0.20 ladder enabled would
charge it for retry windows franken never attempts.
max_context=0 pins cross-window prompt carry OFF on BOTH arms (whisper-cli -mc 0,
franken DecodeParams.max_context=Some(0)). Carry is not a free parameter: franken's
model policy varies it by model and mode (normally n_text_ctx/2, suppressed for
tiny.en segment timestamps), while whisper-cli defaults to -1 = unbounded. Left
unpinned the two arms carry DIFFERENT prompt histories, which changes decode work
and the transcript itself, so the ratio would not be a matched comparison. 0 is the
one value both engines can express exactly.
